## Change summary

Describe the observable behavior and the reason for the change.

## Review checklist

- [ ] Requirement IDs touched are listed in the description.
- [ ] `SPEC.md` is updated when normative behavior changed (§28 rule 4).
- [ ] New normative behavior has a stable ID and `pnpm spec:ids` was run (§28 rule 3).
- [ ] Tests reference the requirements they prove (§28 rule 5).
- [ ] No requirement was weakened, or the weakening has the `spec-change` label and a `CHANGELOG.md` `### Spec` entry (§28 rule 6).
- [ ] Intentional deviations are listed in `specs/requirements.overrides.yaml` with an issue and expiry (§28 rule 7).
- [ ] An ADR was added or updated for an architectural decision.
- [ ] The threat model was updated when the attack surface changed.
- [ ] No secrets or personal data are present in the diff.
- [ ] Commits are signed off with the DCO (`git commit -s`).

## Validation

```text
Commands:
Results:
Known limitations or pending hosted evidence:
```
